info.title: SingleStore Universal API
info.description: SingleStore Flow on Helios Ingest wrapper for configuring source and destination database connections, schedules, table selection, and ingest operations.

post.description: Executes an ingest operation in SingleStore.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

operation.description: Ingest operation to execute. The docs show full, syncnew, syncstruct, and delta.

message.description: Provider message describing the operation result.

success.description: Whether the ingest operation request succeeded.
